basic_info.description:
Set back on a frontage road high above the City, this very special home with unforgettable breathtaking views of San Francisco, is situated in a prime neighborhood close proximity to shopping, restaurants, transportation and beautiful iconic locations and parks. This fully detached 2-level residence offers flexible floor plan, modern upgrades and incredible front and back decks for indoor/outdoor life style and entertaining. 

Rare opportunity to potentially build a second residence behind the main house on this RH-2 lot. Expired plans to add appr. 1,400sf 3-level 1brm home with a roof deck and a spa are available upon request.

Lower Level of the existing house features a spacious en-suite bedroom with a fireplace and an additional independent entry directly from the private pathway, also another guest room that can be used as a bedroom or an office or a family room. This level opens to a front deck featuring a hot tub overlooking stunning SF hills and Downtown views. 

Upper Level boasts open floor plan with a living area with a fireplace and dramatic views of the City, connected to a spacious dining area. Modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, pantry closet and a large breakfast area leads to the expansive back deck, also connected to the private pathway connected to the front gate and the Street. Also on this level is another bedroom with a fireplace and partial views, laundry closet, and a full bath equipped with a unique sink, shower with double shower heads and a jacuzzi tub. 

Additional features include hardwood floors throughout, storage under the front deck, attic accessible from the kitchen, security system and more.

Don’t miss!
